name: verify_quote
description:
Checks that a quote really is in one of this task's documents, climbing the verification ladder: exact match, then a tolerant match (quotes, spacing and case folded), then one paraphrase judge, and three independent votes when the judge is unsure. It returns whether the quote verified, the method, a confidence (exact 1.0, tolerant 0.95, judge at most 0.8, lower for a transcribed image) and where it is. A failed judge call is an error, never a verdict of unverified. Do not use it to search for evidence (use retrieve) or to judge whether a quote supports a legal conclusion: it only says whether the document says it.
Example: {"documentId": "3f6c2a9e-0b1d-4c2e-9a7f-5d8e1b2c4a6f", "quote": "The Supplier's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve months", "claim": null}
